title: daphne taiwanensis
intro: Daphne taiwanensis, commonly known as Taiwanese daphne, is a species of flowering plant in the family Thymelaeaceae. It is a woody, evergreen shrub that grows in the mountainous regions of Taiwan, known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. Taiwanese daphne is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, and is used to treat various conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Taiwanese daphne include daphnetin, daphnodorin, and other flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and fighting off infections.
